source_title: Contaminated Water Triggers Typhoid Outbreak in Gandhinagar, Over 100 Fall Ill (MedBound Times)
quote: Residents of Adivada village and sectors 24, 26, 27 and 29 reported foul smelling and discolored water days before people started falling sick.
notes: UNDATED ('days before people started falling sick'); count not given; single outlet. latest = statement date (officials 4 Jan). Not independently corroborated by PTI/ANI copy I opened.

source_title: Contaminated Water Triggers Typhoid Outbreak in Gandhinagar, Over 100 Fall Ill (MedBound Times)
quote: Health officials confirmed on January 4, 2026 that the outbreak surfaced over the past five days
notes: 'past five days' before 4 Jan -> ~30 Dec 2025 onset (derived). Typhoid (fever); diarrhoea not the main symptom so diarrhoea column blank.

source_title: Gandhinagar typhoid outbreak: Tally of suspected cases rises to 108 after 25 new additions (ThePrint/PTI)
quote: was caused by a leaking water pipeline a few days ago, according to the government.
notes: Leak timing vague ('a few days ago' as of 5 Jan). NHRC (8 Jan) cites 7 leak points in newly laid network; Navbharat (4 Jan) says ~10 leaks.

source_title: Why 100+ Children Pay The Price After Water Contamination In Gujarat's Smart City Gandhinagar (Bombay Samachar English)
quote: with over 100 people predominantly children falling ill after contaminated water entered the drinking water supply.
notes: As of Saturday 3 Jan 2026 (Deputy CM hospital visit); 'over 100' lower bound; CUMULATIVE. Opposition quoted: positive case rate up 50% in last three days.

source_title: Why 100+ Children Pay The Price After Water Contamination In Gujarat's Smart City Gandhinagar (Bombay Samachar English)
quote: Water samples collected from the affected areas of Sector 24, 28 and Adivada tested positive for contamination.
notes: Civil Hospital superintendent Dr Mita Parikh ('The water is not fit for drinking'), ~3 Jan 2026. Sampling date and parameter not stated.

source_title: इंदौर के बाद गुजरात के गांधीनगर में 'जहर' वाला पानी...104 बच्चे बने 'शिकार' (Navbharat Live)
quote: 104 बच्चे बने 'शिकार', पाइपलाइन में मिला लीकेज
notes: Headline: '104 children fell victim; leakage found in pipeline'. CUMULATIVE as of 4 Jan 2026.

source_title: Gujarat: Amit Shah directs administration to "act on war footing" as Gandhinagar faces typhoid outbreak (ANI)
quote: To date, 113 suspected typhoid cases have been identified, and 19 patients receiving treatment have been discharged.
notes: Govt press release 4 Jan 2026. CUMULATIVE suspected typhoid; 94 under treatment (Civil Hospital + UHCs Sector 24, 29).

source_title: Gandhinagar typhoid outbreak: Tally of suspected cases rises to 108 after 25 new additions (ThePrint/PTI)
quote: Yesterday, 367 water samples were collected, and all test results were satisfactory
notes: Deputy CM Harsh Sanghavi on 5 Jan; samples of 4 Jan (post-repair). Conflicts with hospital superintendent's 'tested positive' statement (different samples/time).

source_title: Gandhinagar typhoid outbreak: Tally of suspected cases rises to 108 after 25 new additions (ThePrint/PTI)
quote: At present, 108 patients with suspected typhoid are admitted to our hospital, including 18 new patients admitted today.
notes: NEW admissions 5 Jan 2026 = 18; current suspected in-patients 108; 50 Widal positive; 25 discharged (Civil Hospital).

source_title: Gujarat typhoid outbreak: Over 150 hospitalised in Gandhinagar (Deccan Herald)
quote: as on Monday, a total of 152 patients had been admitted to GMS hospital.
notes: CUMULATIVE admissions as of 5 Jan 2026 (of which 108 suspected typhoid).

source_title: Gujarat typhoid outbreak: Over 150 hospitalised in Gandhinagar (Deccan Herald)
quote: Two children were reported dead, which the hospital authorities claimed were not related to the epidemic.
notes: Hospital attributes deaths to septicaemic shock/DIC and viral encephalopathy; a parent disputed. GMC (6 Jan): 'no deaths reported'. Treat as NOT attributed.

source_title: Gujarat: GMC issues clarification on typhoid cases, says reports of deaths "incorrect, misleading" (ANI)
quote: Total cases registered: 133, Patients discharged: 45, Currently hospitalised: 88.
notes: Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation clarification, 6 Jan 2026. CUMULATIVE.

source_title: Gandhinagar typhoid surge: No need to panic, water quality checked (Asianet Newsable/ANI)
quote: We have collected 2500 to 3000 samples within 3 days
notes: Municipal Commissioner JN Vaghela, 6 Jan 2026 ('quality of drinking water has been checked at all places'). No positive/negative split given.

source_title: NHRC takes suo motu cognisance of reported surge in typhoid cases in Gandhinagar, Gujarat (Akashvani/AIR)
quote: The State Health Department has confirmed a total of 70 active cases of typhoid concentrated in a particular area of the city.
notes: ACTIVE (not cumulative) per NHRC notice 8 Jan 2026; conflicts with higher municipal/hospital figures.
